milestone: D3(a) reactive parry: one readable mid-air block, prompt -> final video
code_commit: the commit that adds this file (pushed before the run)
prompt: Create a cinematic shot of a horned Asura attacking an ascetic defender with a heavy mace in an ancient ruined temple at dusk. The defender parries the blow with a trident. Use a low orbit and push-in.
command: uv run onecreations generate "Create a cinematic shot of a horned Asura attacking an ascetic defender with a heavy mace in an ancient ruined temple at dusk. The defender parries the blow with a trident. Use a low orbit and push-in." --run-id d3_run1

owner_decisions.contact: mid-air block: the downswing stopped on the raised trident, one synced CONTACT
owner_decisions.default_fx: sparks + light-only flash at the 3D contact point; no ground dust/cracks

generation.backend: LTX-2.5 22B distilled INT8 ConvRot + Union IC-LoRA (ComfyUI)
generation.prompt: Cinematic dark fantasy film still: an ancient Indian stone temple courtyard at dusk, massive carved sandstone pillars and stone beams, a stepped shrine tower with a glowing lamp-lit doorway, bronze fire braziers, worn cracked flagstones, warm low sunlight from behind with long shadows and soft atmospheric haze. A huge muscular dark-crimson-skinned asura demon with long curved ivory horns, small tusks, glowing amber eyes and a black mane wears a black iron breastplate and heavy layered spiked iron pauldrons tied with leather shoulder straps, a bronze medallion, a leather belt, a dark loincloth with iron tassets, iron knee guards and greaves, and holds a heavy golden spiked mace. Facing him, a lean ash-blue-skinned ascetic with dark matted hair tied in a bun, a white dhoti and a pale shawl holds a steel trident in a guarding stance. Highly detailed skin, metal and stone textures, dramatic cinematic lighting, subtle film grain.
generation.note: unchanged from D2 (same profile, workflow and seed); only the scene and prompt differ

MACE.provenance: P1: heavy_blunt weapon, mace_strike_blocked_v1 estimated peak 1.51 head widths/frame >= 0.7 (local observation, M2-B/768/M3-A/Showcase)

TRIDENT.provenance: P6: TRIDENT takes part in an authored weapon-on-weapon contact

second_generation_only_if: LTX_GENERATE technical failure (non-zero exit or no output; not the RAM guard)
a post-generation check whose on_fail is 'regenerate' fails (video_valid, output_integrity)
generation_policy.never: regenerate for a failure deterministic repair handles (weapon_integrity, trident_integrity -> repair)
generation_policy.evidence_driven_retry: at most one, only with the owner's go-ahead after the result is reported

acceptance.D3_PASS: AUTONOMY, CONTROL, PIPELINE, FINAL_INTEGRITY and PARRY_READABILITY all PASS
acceptance.D3_PARTIAL: a final video was delivered by the pipeline but one class is not PASS
acceptance.D3_FAIL: no final video delivered, or a delivered video fails FINAL_INTEGRITY

PASS: one invocation of the command above produced deliverables/final.mp4 with exit code 0
no manual Blender / ComfyUI / compositor / frame / file / parameter action between invocation and delivery
no code or configuration change and no --resume needed to reach delivery

preflight: contact_geometry (mace head within 1 cm of the shaft on CONTACT, >= 0.30 m clear 4 frames earlier, no interpenetration, >= 0.10 m body clearance), contact_visible, defender_stationary_root, defender_weapon_axis pass (plus every D2 preflight check)
post-generation: subject_framing, defender_framing (incl. the contact frame), contact_timing (onset within +-2 frames of strike.CONTACT), apex_presence, camera_progression pass
both weapons protected by policy (mace: P1 or P6; trident: P6) and final protected_weapon_present passes
CONTROL.FAIL: a 'fail' post-generation check fails (the run then stops by itself)

PASS: all 15 stages done in order, each with key, times and hashed outputs
effect layers start at the frame derived from strike.CONTACT (= parry.CONTACT)
REPAIR rendered and applied both protected layers (mace_protect, trident_protect) because of the policies
the run status is set by QC (no manual verdict)
final_valid, protected_weapon_present, effects_begin_at_contact, bounded_repair, no_holes all pass

visual, on the final.mp4 contact sheet (recorded separately, not a score): the defender visibly raises the trident and is in the block before the blow arrives; the mace head meets the shaft on the authored frame; the weapons stay in contact through the bind; the mace rebounds; no weapon passes through the other or a body
PARRY_READABILITY.PARTIAL: the contact is on the authored frame but one element above does not read
PARRY_READABILITY.FAIL: no visible contact, or a visible interpenetration

APPEARANCE.note: reported separately; does not decide D3
